pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Lacquer is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A calm, gallery-white nail studio with a single coral chair

children: We opened Lacquer to do nails the way a gallery hangs a picture — on a clean, quiet wall, with nothing competing for the eye but the work itself.
That means realistic booking times, genuinely clean beauty practices, and artists who design to your hands. No rushing, no template sheet, no set you can’t live in.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Every appointment starts with a real look at your nails, your routine and what you actually want to leave with.
Single-use files and buffers, hospital-grade tool sterilisation, and gentle formulas — the standard, not an upgrade.
We finish with aftercare that keeps a set looking new for weeks, and honest advice on when to come back.
